evidence.reason: The implementation at line 64 casts the wrapper's `input` directly to undici's `RequestInfo`. Because `createStepFetch` returns `typeof globalThis.fetch`, callers may pass a native `Request`; undici's converter only recognizes its own `Request` class by `instanceof`, so a native `Request` falls through to `USVString` and becomes `[object Request]`, losing URL/method/headers/body. This is an implementation defect in the intended drop-in fetch behavior, not a new requirement.
